site.name: Abhinav Pangaria
site.longBio: Engineer working across Web3 payments, privacy primitives, on-chain credit, and agent infrastructure. Production shipping across Stellar, Mantle, Polkadot, and Base. Equally at home in research, writing, and architectural design.

dispatches.title: On building infrastructure that actually clears.
The subgraph paradigm: observability as product.
Why Rust is a language of operators.
Notes from a year of mainnet deploys.
Privacy as a primitive, not a feature.

signals.text: If your protocol cannot clear a payment at 3am on a Sunday, it is not infrastructure. It is a demo.
RT: 'The boring path through the system should be the most secure one.' Still the only design heuristic I trust.
Ten million in volume is a number. Ten million in volume without a single rollback is a thesis.
Hackathon arc: twenty-something ships taught me that velocity is a craft, not a temperament.
Builders who answer their own DMs ship faster. No exceptions.

projects.name: PayZoll
projects.tagline: Cross-border payroll and treasury, built for crypto-native teams.
projects.description: The financial 'OS' for the Web3 economy. Originally built for the Stellar Build Better hackathon, PayZoll executes multi-hop path payments to settle global payroll in a single click. From contract-level path formation to automated asset swaps and institutional-grade dashboards, it bridges the legacy-fiat gap with production-grade efficiency.

projects.name: OpenAssets
projects.tagline: The Mantle-native gateway bridging the RWA liquidity gap.
projects.description: A fundamental Real-World Asset (RWA) execution layer. Built for the Mantle Global Hackathon, OpenAssets transforms off-chain cash flows into credit-enabled primitives. Featuring ERC-3643 (T-REX) compliance, mETH-powered leverage vaults, and 'Token-Day' engines to prevent yield sniping. A system built for the next cycle of institutional RealFi.

projects.name: Tesseract
projects.tagline: Privacy-preserving payment & identity mixing on Stellar.
projects.description: Deposit, wait, withdraw. Built for the Stellar Build Better hackathon (1st Place winning team), Tesseract severs the link between depositor and recipient. Featuring channel-account rotation and layered hybrid encryption, it ensures that the most boring path through the system is also the most private one.

projects.name: Kredio
projects.tagline: DeFi with memory. Polkadot's on-chain credit layer.
projects.description: The decentralized credit layer for Polkadot. Kredio uses hybrid EVM ↔ PolkaVM atomic calls to score borrowers against on-chain behavior. Featuring the YieldMind intelligence layer and NeuralScorer for real-time manipulation detection, it enables zero-oracle risk assessment across parachains via XCM.

projects.name: Clear Sky
projects.tagline: The trust layer for climate data. DePIN meets verifiable IP.
projects.description: Environmental sensor readings (AQI, CO₂, temperature) become cryptographic intellectual property. ECDSA-signed payloads minted as IP on Story Protocol, anchored by Coinbase Smart Wallet, preventing fake data and unlocking monetization.

episodes.title: The Apprenticeship.
episodes.subtitle: Theory meets the wire at IIIT.
episodes.excerpt: IIIT Guwahati, first semester. A 9.55 CGPA and a stubborn refusal to write throwaway code. Algorithms by day, debugging Linux stacks at 2am.

body.text: College began as a race for technical depth. While the syllabus covered the basics, I was building my own detention center for bugs. Writing malloc from scratch to understand segfaults, scraping portals before there was a polite reason to, and obsessing over the distance between a textbook example and the actual wire.
Phase 01 / The Foundation
Learning to see the system.

The 9.55 CGPA wasn't about the grades, it was about the discipline of completion. I learned early that taste comes from quantity. The path from first-year to mainnet isn't a leap, it is a thousand boring repetitions until you stop being surprised by your own mistakes.

episodes.title: The Crucible.
episodes.subtitle: 4-day sprints and solo marathons.
episodes.excerpt: A series of high-stakes wins across Stellar, Polkadot, and Mantle. From a 4-day solo marathon mastering path payments to winning honorary awards in new ecosystems, this is where technical intuition was forged.

body.text: The arc reached its peak during the 4-day Stellar 'Build Better' Hackathon. Entering as a newcomer, I chose a high-risk path: solo-coding the entire infrastructure. I spent the first 12 hours deep in the core protocol docs, mapping out a solution others deemed impossible for a sprint: a complex multi-hop path payment system that handled asset conversion mid-flow. It secured 1st place and validated a core thesis: deep technical empathy is the ultimate force multiplier.
Phase 02 / The Operator
Systems that clear.
Winning is a byproduct of planning. From solo marathons on Stellar to hybrid EVM / Wasm logic on Polkadot, the goal was never just to 'finish', it was to build systems that clear under pressure.

The momentum shifted to Polkadot, where I built Kredio. As a newcomer to Substrate, I implemented cross-chain credit scoring via XCM, earning an Honorary Award. This continued with the Mantle Global Hackathon, where my team and I architected OpenAssets. These weren't trophies, they were the evidence of the production-grade architect I am today.

episodes.title: The Mainnet Season.
episodes.subtitle: Scaling from incubation to Stellar mainnet.
episodes.excerpt: PayZoll evolved from an Open Campus incubation into a global rails provider. Institutional capital moving through systems that don't sleep.

body.text: PayZoll began as a thesis on friction. Capital moves slowly between borders and blockchains. Starting with the Educhain Open Campus incubation, we built for scale. The $100K SCF grant from the Stellar Development Foundation turned the prototype into a company. We focused on the vision of capital that moves now, not later.
Phase 03 / Conviction
Engineering as a thesis.

Today, we are integrating with Mudrex (Saber) to harden the liquidity bridge. We chose Rust and Go because they are languages of operators, not narratives. Scaling to Stellar mainnet isn't just a milestone, it's the result of building infrastructure that actually clears at 3am on a Sunday.

episodes.title: RealFi Mastery.
episodes.subtitle: Bridging the RWA liquidity gap.
episodes.excerpt: From the U2U Vietbuild win to Mantle-native RWA layers. Moving beyond hackathon products to fundamental financial primitives.

body.text: OpenAssets found its niche in the gap between trade receivables and on-chain liquidity. We first proved the concept at the Vietbuild hackathon for U2U network, taking home the win. But a hackathon product is just a sketch. We redesigned and revamped the entire stack for the Mantle Network, focusing on ERC-3643 (T-REX) compliance and institutional-grade security.
Phase 04 / Primitives
The RWA Primitive.
If your protocol cannot handle compliant Real-World Assets with the precision of a legacy bank, you are playing a game. We built OpenAssets to be the fundamental service.

We implemented mETH-powered leverage vaults and universal credit abstraction (OAID). It was a season of high-stakes architectural decisions, transforming a 48-hour win into a cornerstone of the Mantle ecosystem.

episodes.title: Privacy as Primitive.
episodes.subtitle: Building temporal decorrelation on Stellar.
episodes.excerpt: Deposit, wait, withdraw. A Distributor severs the link between depositors and recipients. The most boring path is the most private one.

body.text: Privacy as a feature is marketing. Privacy as a primitive is architecture. Tesseract makes that distinction concrete: a mechanism where a detached Distributor handles outflow, breaking the on-chain link between depositor and recipient. Channel-account rotation, hybrid encryption, and BullMQ-backed scheduling ensure that the system remains stable and private.
Phase 05 / Mastery
The silent protocol.

I came out of the Soroban season with a much narrower set of opinions and a much wider set of scars. Both compound. The result is a protocol that does one thing perfectly: it clears private payments without the theater of 'zero-knowledge' marketing.
